title: Three-way care, a jackal’s feast
odia:
ତିନି ଥେଣ୍ଟିଆ କାକୁଡ଼ି ବାଡ଼ି
ଶିଆଳ ଖାଏ ମୋଡି ମାଡି।
literal_meaning: A cucumber patch under three-way care; a jackal eats, twisting and trampling.
meaning_odia: ତିନିଜଣଙ୍କ ଦାୟିତ୍ୱରେ ଥିବା କାକୁଡ଼ି ବାଡ଼ିରେ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଅନ୍ୟଜଣ ଦେଖିବେ ବୋଲି ଭାବି କାମ ଛାଡ଼ିଦେଲେ। ଫଳରେ ବାଡ଼ି ଅରକ୍ଷିତ ରହିଲା ଓ ଶିଆଳ କାକୁଡ଼ି ମୋଡ଼ିମାଡ଼ି ଖାଇଲା। ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ ଭାଗ ହୋଇଥିଲେ ବି କେହି ତାହା ନନେଲେ କ୍ଷତି ହୁଏ।
explanation: Three people share responsibility for the cucumber patch, but each leaves the work to the others. No one protects the crop, and the jackal eats its way through it. Shared responsibility fails when everyone expects someone else to act.
usage_example: Original imagined example: Three teams are responsible for inspecting a store, but each assumes another has done it. Supplies spoil before anyone checks. Someone recalls the unguarded cucumber patch.
cultural_context: The jackal does more than take a neat share: the repeated actions suggest eating amid twisting and trampling. The image makes neglected protection visible as damage to a crop.

witnesses.locator: Page22, first item beginning ତିନି ଥେଣ୍ଟିଆ.

graphic.alt: Three people watch a jackal eating fallen fruit beneath a damaged cucumber trellis, with three baskets nearby.
graphic.caption: An imagined shared watch leaves the crop unprotected.

odia_summary: ଭାଗ ହୋଇଥିବା ଦାୟିତ୍ୱରେ ଦେଖାଶୁଣା ଅବହେଳିତ ହେଲେ କ୍ଷତି ହୋଇପାରେ।
english_summary: Everyone leaves the shared task to someone else, and the crop goes unprotected.
